summary.en: HRPF’s 2025 report records improvements in sanitation and facility management at Dar-ul-Aman following its complaint to the Provincial Ombudsman.

blocks.text: HRPF submitted a detailed complaint concerning sanitation, healthcare and oversight at Dar-ul-Aman. The 2025 report describes administrative inquiries, corrective measures and improvements in the shelter’s condition. This record covers the reported intervention, rather than claiming that every continuing need has been resolved.
Source: HRPF 2025 Progress Report.pdf, pages 14–15. The cover is an illustrative photograph from the supplied HRPF archive, not a verified photograph of this specific intervention.

summary.en: The 2024 report documents cleaning and repairs to the local sewerage scheme, including damaged pipes and roadside openings.

blocks.text: HRPF’s 2024 report describes completed cleaning and repair work in Mianwal Ranjha. Broken pipes were repaired and roadside openings were raised. A separate request to increase the Fifth Drain’s capacity is recorded as a request, not a completed expansion.

Source: HRPF PROGRESS REPORT 2024 Revised.docx, Repair and Cleaning of Sewerage Scheme. The cover is an illustrative photograph from the supplied HRPF archive, not a verified photograph of this specific intervention.

sourceReferences: PROGRESS REPORT 2024 Revised.docx, Repair and Cleaning of Sewerage Scheme

summary.en: The 2022–2023 report records HRPF’s visits to health facilities and engagement with Punjab health authorities over difficulties accessing childhood vaccination.

blocks.text: According to HRPF’s 2022–2023 performance report, administrative issues at Basic Health Units and District Health Units affected childhood vaccination access. HRPF visited facilities and informed the Director General of Health Punjab. The report records a response to improve the situation. An exact starting year and number of children reached are not supplied.

Source: HRPF PROGRESS REPORT HRPF 2023.pdf, Improvement in the Health Sector and Access to Vaccination. The cover is an illustrative photograph from the supplied HRPF archive, not a verified photograph of this specific intervention.

sourceReferences: PROGRESS REPORT HRPF 2023.pdf, Improvement in the Health Sector and Access to Vaccination

excerpt.en: The 2025 report describes HRPF’s petition about unsafe conditions and missing facilities at Government Primary School Mianwal Ranjha.

blocks.text: HRPF’s 2025 report records a petition to the Provincial Ombudsman Punjab concerning Government Primary School Mianwal Ranjha. The report says the Ombudsman took notice and initiated measures to address the concerns. It does not establish that a complete school reconstruction was finished.

This article summarises a supplied historical HRPF report. The date shown on the website is the publication date of this summary, not the date of the original incident. Source: 2025 Progress Report.pdf, page 13. The cover is an illustrative HRPF archive photograph.

title.en: Calling for Action on Canal Water Pollution

excerpt.en: HRPF’s 2024 report documents concerns about sewage and poultry waste contaminating canal water in Mandi Bahauddin.

blocks.text: The 2024 report describes HRPF’s engagement with Punjab environment authorities over canal-water contamination. It records notices issued to poultry farm owners, referrals to the Environmental Tribunal and a complaint before the Provincial Ombudsman. These are reported advocacy steps, not a claim that all pollution has been eliminated.

This article summarises a supplied historical HRPF report. The date shown on the website is the publication date of this summary, not the date of the original incident. Source: PROGRESS REPORT 2024 Revised.docx, HRPF Concerns About Contamination of Canal Freshwater. The cover is an illustrative HRPF archive photograph.

sourceReferences: PROGRESS REPORT 2024 Revised.docx, HRPF Concerns About Contamination of Canal Freshwater

excerpt.en: HRPF’s 2025 report highlights awareness, documentation and advocacy concerning dangerous migration and human trafficking.

blocks.text: The 2025 report describes HRPF’s awareness work, documentation and advocacy concerning human smuggling and trafficking in Mandi Bahauddin. It calls for stronger accountability, safer migration pathways and support for affected families. This summary omits identifying details of victims and unverified allegations about individuals.

This article summarises a supplied historical HRPF report. The date shown on the website is the publication date of this summary, not the date of the original incident. Source: 2025 Progress Report.pdf, pages 8–11. The cover is an illustrative HRPF archive photograph.
